name: @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch
description: DSH community plugin: probe any set of models — each asked to draw an *animated* SVG 'pelican riding a bicycle' on a fixed interval — and lay every drawing out on a read-only board. No scoring: the pictures are the result. Calls go through DSH's own model service, so every provider the app has (including the signed-in DeepSeek account) is selectable, and the plugin never handles a key. Settings live in the panel behind one gear button.
author: milu
